source: Native close-up readings of the 2020 west/east address signs, a 2015 and a 2017 frame beneath the lintel, the 2017 west guardroom and the 2020 passage paving.
notes: The east white patch at (303,544) lies at the blurred outside of the photographed digit 2. It hits red paint on the substitute digit; the observed pixel has a red cast.

The eastern extremity of the lid at (566,515) exceeds the local two-pixel radius of the fitted circular ring. The measured radial RMS is 3.7 cm when rays from the facade camera are projected to grade.
A separate set of 42 longitudinal sightlines samples a 2.4-metre-wide by 2.3-metre-high interior rectangle. Each extends from outside the entry through the covered lane.
